texto.es: Tu esteticista revisa tu cuero cabelludo y tipo de cabello antes de empezar, para armar el ritual segun lo que de verdad necesitas.
texto.en: Your esthetician checks your scalp and hair type first, so the ritual that follows is built around what you actually need.

texto.es: Vapor tibio y una limpieza suave abren el cuero cabelludo y ablandan la acumulacion antes de seguir con el masaje.
texto.en: Warm steam and a gentle cleanse open the scalp and soften buildup before anything else happens.

texto.es: El masaje craneal lento que las reseñas repiten una y otra vez, combinado con aceite tibio o piedras calientes segun tu ritual.
texto.en: The slow, hands-on massage reviewers mention again and again, worked in with warm oil or hot stones depending on your ritual.

texto.es: Una mascarilla o serum nutritivo cierra la visita, para que salgas con el cuero cabelludo y el cabello realmente restaurados.
texto.en: A nourishing mask or serum finishes the visit, so you leave with your scalp and hair actually restored.

items.quote: The experience at this spa was, without a doubt, the most relaxing I’ve ever had. Leticia and Angela were absolutely amazing and took exceptional care of both my daughter and me from the moment we arrived. I booked this as part of my daughter’s 21st birthday celebration, and it made the day even more special.

Had such an amazing experience at Haus Head Spa! Leticia was absolutely incredible. She was so welcoming, attentive, and made the entire experience unbelievably relaxing from start to finish. The head spa treatment itself was amazing and my scalp and hair felt so refreshed afterward.

I went in for the head spa and had Irina do my service. She arrived before my appointment and we started on time. She was very knowledgeable and did an amazing job with the treatment, and made sure to offer drinks/snacks. It was very relaxing and my scalp looked and felt amazing afterwards!
